page.overview:
Who is Orinus Atkascha?

Orinus Atkascha, also styled as Orinas,, is a character mentioned in Final Fantasy Tactics. The infant son of King Ondoria III and Queen Louveria, Prince Orinus is an heir to the throne of Ivalice, having a claim alongside Princess Ovelia. His infancy means that whoever has guardianship over him would rule Ivalice as regent. Duke Goltanna and Duke Larg compete for guardianship over him, but Goltanna later backs Ovelia for queen, while Larg backs Orinus for king, resulting in the War of the Lions.

Orinus was the third and last son born to King Ondoria III and Queen Louveria. He was conceived when Ondoria was sickly, and his birth surprised the council, who had assassinated Louveria's first two sons in the hope Ovelia would take the throne. After his birth, Ovelia was left in the care of Duke Larg, and the council's plan to have her take the throne was complicated.

At Orinus' birthday celebration, his father collapsed. This sparked concerns for his health, particularly as he had not named an heir nor a regent who would watch over Prince Orinus. Dukes Larg and Goltanna competed for guardianship at first, but Duke Goltanna later moved to crown Ovelia queen and marched in her name, while Duke Larg insisted Prince Orinus was the rightful heir. The schism sparked the War of the Lions.

After Duke Larg was assassinated at Fort Besselat, Orinus led the life of a fugitive and took refuge in Romanda, despite the efforts of Ovelia, now queen of Ivalice, to find and capture him.
